inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: tegrastats、CPU/process、GPU fd 所有权、冷热/频率/温度/后台活动；按测量协议给出可用/受干扰/证据不足。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 继承 v2；补完整采样窗口与归属，不能将驻留进程等同活跃竞争。

inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: 真实请求来源、tokenizer/chat template、token IDs/body hash、请求 ID、输出 token/结束原因，重复请求逐次对应。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 针对 Qwen3.8 重建有版本的工作量集，不能复制 Qwen3.6 token ID 或机械继承 33 请求数量。

inventory.capability: 可配置 warmup/多请求/独立重复
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: round-major 多请求、warmup 与正式样本分开、原始每次结果、输出重复性检查。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 支持长短输入及不同输出长度、重复轮次；预先声明样本预算。

inventory.capability: 客户端与模型阶段时间
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: 外部 TTFT/总耗时与引擎 Prefill/Decode、生成速率分别定义；短输出无 decode 数据时为空。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 用可访问的 vLLM 原生指标/受控观察提取，未知不能由客户端时间戳强拆。

inventory.capability: 逐 token 与分布统计
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: 后续 token 时长及 count/min/median/p95/max、TTFT/TPOT 分位数/按请求长度分桶。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 保存真实 token 事件或核实每 chunk 恰一 token；否则 chunk 与 token 指标分列，不能混称。

inventory.capability: 内存水位和长时资源趋势
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: 每次调用前后 CUDA 可用内存、持久下降、RSS/fd/thread、温度频率；有限 soak 与新进程复核。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 适配 Jetson 统一内存，区分采样峰值与瞬时峰值；建立可配置有限 soak 和恢复观测，勿照抄 Orin 内存阈值。

inventory.capability: 退出后资源恢复与 nvmap 诊断
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: 认证已运行进程/二进制与父子观察，退出前后 nvmap 分配/孤儿/池保留，no_owner_leak 或 inconclusive。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 保留只读诊断；权限不足明确 capability gap，不通过清空系统池制造恢复。无需移植特定 AOT 核心。

inventory.capability: 实际执行路径/阶段 profile
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: NVTX 阶段范围、Graph replay/fallback、实际后端/配置/route计数、Nsight 内核耗时/调用和非 kernel 空隙。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 采集与基准计时分开；生产等价配置不可被 eager 形状样例替代。重叠 kernel 时间不能简单相加当请求占比。

inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: B-C-C-B 独立进程、相同请求输出/usage、Prefill/Decode/TTFT 分别比较和失败校验。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 复用测量和身份校验；去掉必须提速或性能选型/推广门槛，差异与不确定性如实报告。

inventory.capability: 流完整性与请求边界观测
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: SSE 完成/结束标志、usage、stream/nonstream、UTF-8 多语言、超限不截断、请求与内部 witness 绑定。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 在现有 API 上运行客户端与日志关联，验证测量有效性；不开发 API 服务。

inventory.capability: 取消/排队/慢读与恢复观测
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: prefill/decode 取消后恢复、慢 SSE 消费、活动+排队+过载、下一请求输出/健康与资源。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 只在专有临时等价实例执行压力/取消用例；按现有 vLLM 服务合同观测，不能强迫变成 Orin 的 1 active+1 queued+429。

inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: MTP target/draft/accepted/committed token 与时长计数；选层激活 hashes/统计/固定样本用于定位。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 观测已有 MTP 与选层实际输入；不实现新 MTP、层内算法或完整模型 oracle。模型精确输出差异需语义说明。

inventory.capability: 冷暖状态、加载及可复核交付
inventory.evidence_class: implemented code / procedure; selected historical device records exist, not rerun by reviewer
inventory.capability_summary: 进程启动/模型加载身份与状态、cache准备与实际命中语义、原始数据/遥测/版本/失败/退出码/离线复核。
inventory.thor_adaptation: 冷启动在专有实例测，主服务不重启；不能把相同请求自动视为冷缓存；所有结果有配置和证据。

exclusions: Engine/API/tokenizer/queue/cache/MTP implementation and optimized kernels: excluded by user; observe their current behavior only.
Fixed Qwen3.6 model/profile/layer counts/SM87 route certification are partner-engine-specific, not Thor acceptance fields.
Architecture winner search, promotion thresholds, kernel parameter sweeps and q20 speculative transaction simulator are optimization research, not probe parity.

98-question C-Eval capability publication and full generated-answer quality qualification are partner engine release tests; retain response/usage/token integrity and numeric probes, not an unrelated general-model evaluation product.
Roadmap-only 60K/130K capacity, target 2s/4s TTFT, indefinite/saturation reliability are not implemented parity targets.
cautions: ReferenceBenchmark device-memory sampling is between invocations and explicitly not in-request peak memory.
Partner concurrency code tests bounded active/queued/overload recovery; it is not evidence of arbitrary concurrency-scale throughput support.
Two-hour historical soak has declared pacing and thermal stop limits; it is not maximum-load saturation qualification.
Scripts implement measured observability; retained project metadata is evidence reported by author, not an independent rerun in this review.
All probe capabilities require a current source-to-product matrix; unsupported may explain hardware readout absence, not unimplemented required tooling.
